# A Canadian company sells US-listed shares, and writes the sale wholly in US
# dollars.
#
# The shares have a cost basis in Canadian dollars: 20 bought for 5,200.00 CAD,
# 260.00 a share. Selling 8 of them for 2,080.00 USD draws that cost basis down
# by 2,080.00 CAD of cost and realizes whatever the dollars fetched above it —
# and a transaction with no split in Canadian dollars has nowhere to state that
# figure, while the dollars it brings in arrive with no cost to open a cost
# basis at. So the sale is refused, as a repayment written wholly in US dollars
# that realizes a difference is, and written again in Canadian dollars with
# `$residual$`.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_share_sale_stating_no_canadian_figure_is_refused.py.
2034-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2034-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2034-01-01 commodity USD_TECH
	mnemonic: "USD_TECH"
	fullname: "A technology company whose shares are priced in US dollars"
	namespace: "NASDAQ"
	fraction: 10000
2034-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2034-01-01 open Assets:CAD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2034-01-01 open Assets:USD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2034-01-01 open Assets:Tech Shares
	type: "Stock"
	commodity.namespace: "NASDAQ"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD_TECH"
2034-01-01 open Equity
	type: "Equity"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

	type: "Equity"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2034-01-01 open Income
	type: "Income"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2034-01-01 open Income:Realized Gains
	type: "Income"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2034-01-02 * "Opening capital"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank 10000.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening -10000.00 CAD

2034-01-08 * "Buy 20 USD_TECH for 5,200.00 CAD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Tech Shares 20.0000 USD_TECH
		guid: "a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a90001"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD_TECH"
		share_price: "260"
		value: "5200.00"
	Assets:CAD Bank -5200.00 CAD

2034-06-30 * "Sell 8 USD_TECH for 2,080.00 USD, written wholly in US dollars"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Tech Shares -8.0000 USD_TECH
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD_TECH"
		share_price: "260"
		value: "-2080.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a90001"
	Assets:USD Bank 2080.00 USD
